summary: Tested job scoping and the 'Your Jobs' rename on backend and frontend. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass. yusuf and bd see all jobs. Other users only see jobs they are assigned to. The ?assignee filter works only for yusuf/bd; regular members can't use it to see other people's jobs. kalpesh gets 404 on GET and PATCH of OS-018. bd can PATCH OS-018 (the change was saved and then put back). View-as (X-View-As) is scoped correctly. Frontend: the sidebar nav-jobs label and jobs-heading say 'All Jobs' for yusuf/bd and 'Your Jobs' for rupali/kalpesh/aayush/digital. yusuf/bd see 7 pills: Everyone plus real users, with team-filter-<user_id> testids. Filtering by u_arjun, u_priya, u_meera and all works. No old demo names. Non-full users see no pills. Rupali sees OS-018; Kalpesh/Aayush/Ved see an empty list. Board is scoped the same way. yusuf viewing as Rupali sees 'Your Jobs' and OS-018 with no pills; as Kalpesh, an empty list; going back to self restores 'All Jobs' with 7 pills. bd can open the OS-018 modal, which has the status select.

minor.issue: There is no endpoint to delete a job. The TEST_ job created during testing had to be removed directly in Mongo (done; only OS-018 remains). A TEST_ job would otherwise only be purged on backend restart.

The job id is count-based (OS-{count+1}). With only OS-018 present, the next job is OS-002. Once deletions happen, ids can clash with existing ones (e.g. OS-018 again once the count reaches 17), and there is no unique index. Use a max-id or counter sequence instead.

issues: Kalpesh, Aayush and Ved see 'No jobs match.' even with no filters set. A message like 'No jobs assigned to you yet' would be clearer.
The top of the modal appears to sit under the sticky topbar, and the dark backdrop seems to stop partway down the viewport. Minor, and possibly an older issue; not confirmed beyond one screenshot.

action_items: Optional: add DELETE /api/jobs/{id} (manager only), or document that jobs can't be deleted
Optional: switch job id generation away from count+1 to avoid id clashes
Optional: show a clearer empty-state message on Your Jobs
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _apply_role_filter also treats any is_admin user as full access. This matches the frontend hasFullJobAccess and is fine.
server.py: create_job is manager_only, so bd can view and edit all jobs but cannot create them. This matches the request (view and edit).
TAB_LABELS.jobs in tabs.js is still 'All Jobs'. Only the Tab Visibility admin screen (owner only) uses it, so this is acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_scope_job (OS-002, assigned to u_priya) during the pytest run. The test now deletes it through Mongo in a finally block. Verified that only OS-018 remains. OS-018's status was changed and restored to 'active'.
